title: Premium and Member Cost-Share Billing on Special Needs Plans Enrollments
content:
Where a Special Needs Plans package carries a plan premium it is billed for each coverage month from the coverage effective date to the coverage end date, on the package's due day.

### The standing the enrollment must hold

> The enrollment is in a status of active or deemed continued eligibility on the day the charge is posted.

That condition governs a charge, a payment and a credit alike. It is tested on the enrollment record, matched to the enrollment being posted to, before the entry is posted, and on the status the register holds rather than on the standing the member believes they have. It is met on those two statuses and on no other.

### The amount of a premium charge, and the account it moves

The amount of a plan premium charge for a coverage month is the package's monthly plan premium. Charges posted to the enrollment increase the plan premium and member cost share owed but not yet paid; money the member pays and credits granted reduce it; and the running total of those entries is the premium balance due on the enrollment.

### A member protected from cost share

A member in a Medicaid category the package protects owes no plan cost share at all, and a charge raised against such a member is relieved by a credit rather than pursued.

### The Part B premium bought down

The Part B premium the package buys down is paid by the state or the plan directly to Medicare and never appears on the member's own account.

### How money and credits are applied

Money is posted against the oldest unpaid coverage month first, and a credit always names the single charge it relieves and the reason it was granted.

### A provider's bill to a protected member

A member protected from cost share who is nevertheless billed by a provider is told the bill is improper, and the plan takes it up with the provider rather than leaving the member to argue.

### Points of judgement

| Standing the enrollment holds on the day of posting | May a charge, a payment or a credit be posted? |
| --- | --- |
| Active | Yes |
| Deemed continued eligibility | Yes |
| Enrollment submitted | No |
| Eligibility verification | No |
| Terminated for loss of the qualifying need | No |
| Disenrolled | No |
